bio: Awoo there, fellow Shibas!  It's Luvie Bubbles here, ready to bring you the fluffiest streams on the internet!  I'm obsessed with all things Shiba, and I love sharing my passion for variety streams with my awesome community.  Join the Shiba Squad for good vibes, hilarious moments.
